subject: website
name: Stoner Rock Radio
summary: Stoner Rock Radio, a web radio page with Nostr and wallet features. No public repository was found. It is Level 2: when it opens it runs GoatCounter analytics from gc.zgo.at and about 29 modules from esm.sh (nostr-tools, noble hashes), none with an integrity hash. It also fetches its playlist and images from dbloops.com, Pinata, and a Nostr relay at relay.damus.io.
